<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-US" class="no-js">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge,chrome=1">
  <title>Shipping Software for Ecommerce Fulfillment - ShipStation</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="google-site-verification" content="L7hdQTq1jIhk-b7Czw9R-Mao3JOJ_T5SUIky4FCfc50" />
  <meta name="facebook-domain-verification" content="ejtdwgoxeugo393ube0m4qy5muymps" />
<script>
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    // Consent Mode default: deny until OneTrust says otherwise. Must be queued before any
    // OneTrust event reaches the dataLayer. Without a default GTM treats consent as granted,
    // so the first OneTrustGroupsUpdated (queued ahead of OneTrust's `consent update`) fired
    // every ad_storage-gated pixel on a visitor's first visit, GPC included.
    function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
    gtag('consent', 'default', {
      ad_storage: 'denied',
      analytics_storage: 'denied',
      ad_user_data: 'denied',
      ad_personalization: 'denied',
      functionality_storage: 'denied',
      wait_for_update: 500
    });
    var _ssCookie = document.cookie.split(';').find(function(c){ return c.trim().startsWith('SSHome='); });
    dataLayer.push({ 'isCustomer': _ssCookie ? 'Yes' : 'No' });

     - when(id, cb): run cb once category `id` is active (immediately if it already is).

     window.ssConsent directly, unguarded.

	var listeners = [];

	var gpcOptOut = false;
	var gpcFallbackTimer;

	// can strip C0004 by itself on seeing GPC, but only UpdateConsent RECORDS a response,
	// which is what downstream gates (GTM) key on. Returns true when the active groups are
	// about to change, i.e. OneTrust will re-invoke OptanonWrapper with post-GPC groups and
	// ready/flush must wait for it; false when the groups are already post-GPC.

		}

	// callback that calls when()/whenReady() (and triggers a nested flush) can neither be
	// dropped nor re-run. Items still waiting on a category are put back afterwards.

			return;

		var waiting = [];
		queue = [];
		pending.forEach(function (item) {
			if (item.id === null || has(item.id)) {

	// `consent update` after an explicit banner choice (or GPC), so a visitor under
	// consent-assumed would otherwise stay denied. On the first genuine consent event,

	// subscribers. Subscribers are NOT notified from flush(), so registering a
	// when()/whenReady() consumer after ready never re-fires them.

		clearTimeout(gpcFallbackTimer);

		answered: bannerAnswered,
		when: function (id, cb) {

		whenReady: function (cb) {

			flush();
		},
		subscribe: function (cb) {
			listeners.push(cb);
			if (ready) {

			}

<script>
(function () {
  var CURRENT_DOMAIN = window.location.hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
  var STORAGE_PREFIX = 'ss_attribution_';

  function getDomain(url) {
    try {
      return new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function isExternalReferrer(referrer) {
    if (!referrer) return false;

    var referrerDomain = getDomain(referrer);
    if (!referrerDomain) return false;

    return referrerDomain !== CURRENT_DOMAIN;
  }

  function setIfMissing(key, value) {
    if (!localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + key) && value) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + key, value);
    }
  }

  function setAlways(key, value) {
    if (value) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + key, value);
    }
  }

  var referrer = document.referrer;

  // Only store external referrers.
  // This avoids overwriting latest_referrer with internal ShipStation page-to-page navigation.
  if (!isExternalReferrer(referrer)) return;

  var referrerDomain = getDomain(referrer);
  var currentUrl = window.location.href;
  var timestamp = new Date().toISOString();

  // First-touch attribution: only set once.
  setIfMissing('original_referrer', referrer);
  setIfMissing('original_referrer_domain', referrerDomain);
  setIfMissing('original_landing_page', currentUrl);
  setIfMissing('original_referrer_timestamp', timestamp);

  // Latest-touch attribution: update every time a new external referrer appears.
  setAlways('latest_referrer', referrer);
  setAlways('latest_referrer_domain', referrerDomain);
  setAlways('latest_landing_page', currentUrl);
  setAlways('latest_referrer_timestamp', timestamp);
})();
</script>
